Hi
I am writing this and must advise all correspondence is being documented.
I am not aware of your relationship with the local business owner who posted the review you have decided to comment on.
I must stress that the police are now dealing with this and that all comments across all platforms both public and personal have been passed to them.
The actual evidence to actually back up this accusation will be requested to establish real evidence not circumstantial and unsupported at this time.
I do fully agree on any abuse of any animal is a crime for which “when proven” should be brought to justice.
But, I also know that defamation, slander and harassment online is also a crime that “ with the evidence “ should be brought to justice.
I only write this, as after the well documented tragedy of Caroline Flack, I would think people would be more careful on what they send to people without any involvement or actual evidence.
As stated, this is now with the authorities.
My reasons for writing is to inform that the individual that all those that have decided to attack with 1 persons unsupported review, is now currently in a serious condition after the attempt of taking there own life.
I do trust that the police will contact all who got involved to establish evidence backing such comments, but at this time it is not known under what circumstances they will be investigating until known outcome of the said persons condition
As long as your conscience is clean and back your involvement then hopefully all “actual “ not circumstantial evidence will prevail and truth be punished accordingly
This note and any correspondence has also been added to the investigation
First time here, my dogs loved it and were looked after really well. We'd definitely use them again for boarding and they have a day catering option

Friendly and knowledgeable staff and good facilities. My dogs are always well looked after, and communication is great, especially when they've stayed for a few nights and I've asked for updates. Would recommend.

Staff are great however Dave (Boss?) is not an understanding man. Staff had confirmed that I could pick my dog up from day care early for a very short period of time due to personal circumstances. These had briefly been explained to him directly and he still proceeded to gently argue that this was not acceptable. I believe he blocked off the day care reception and waited for my arrival to have a conversation. Definitely not sending my dog back here as the management is not flexible or communicating properly with staff.

My dog came back unwell and had clearly lost weight. He really wasn’t himself. Whilst that may have been unavoidable, I can’t excuse them returning his bed full of sick. I will never use them again. For the prices they charge, I expected so much more. Avoid.
Great experience. Team were wonderful. The pup updates on socials were a great release while we were away and the boy enjoyed his first stay.
Best kennels I’ve experienced in West Midlands

Unfortunately, this kennel has changed a lot. I have been a loyal customer for many years, but this will be my last visit with my dog. They claim that dogs are taken out at least once a day, but this was not the case for my boy. Over 10 days, he was taken out only once, and I was told this was because he was "too nervous." This was only communicated to me after I specifically asked, and even then, I had to wait over 24 hours for a reply.

I was also told they were extremely busy, which made me feel that they are prioritizing their doggy daycare service over the care of boarding dogs. Meanwhile, it seems they have plenty of time for their staff's pets.

I’m deeply disappointed and will not be returning. I can no longer trust them to provide the level of care they once did.
